# Tesslane

> Tesslane is an MIT-licensed, local-first AI coding agent dashboard for Codex and Claude Code. It coordinates feature planning, agent execution, Git worktrees, approvals, checks and independent reviews.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane. The maintained application is in src/web/. Installation requires a retained full checkout; the agent skill opens the dashboard for a target project.

This is an optional documentation index. Links below point to plain-text sources on the current main branch. Tagged releases and commit URLs identify immutable versions. Provider validation boundaries are recorded in implementation status; the specification and archived experiments contain intended or historical designs.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/README.md): Product definition, core workflow and quick start.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/FAQ.md): Engines, installation, platforms, costs, privacy and citation.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Prerequisites, full-clone installation, updates and troubleshooting.
- [Workspace guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Feature decisions, execution controls, delivery and recovery.

## Architecture and evidence

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Local engine, native provider adapters, source map and execution boundaries.
- [Implementation status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/implementation/STATUS.md): Implemented behavior, real-provider evidence and remaining validation.
- [Validation evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/implementation/VALIDATION.md): Reproducible checks and the distinction between fixtures and genuine inference.
- [Privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/docs/PRIVACY.md): Local state, provider data flow and optional browser dictation.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lorenzo-Coslado/tesslane/main/SECURITY.md): Local trust boundary and private vulnerability reporting.
